messages:
Nina: quick report from onboarding orpheus-28k (int4). Repro shows token drift only when context > 28k and prefetch-window not divisible by 4096. float16 baseline clean. suspect RoPE wrapping + async prefetch ordering.
Ravi: can you paste the repro command and which quant pipeline?
Nina: branch feature/quant-stability, pipeline=q-int4-v2. repro: `./tools/long_prefill_test --model orpheus-28k --quant int4 --context 30000 --prefetch-window 12288 --seed 13`
Omar: saw similar pattern before; non-power-of-two window sizes can shift the wrap point relative to rotary tile boundaries. try 8192 and 16384 for comparison.
Camille: also try forcing kernel scheduling: `--force-kernel=scalar` vs `--force-kernel=vector` to see if timing affects order.
Nina: I ran quick diffs: 8192 -> diverge at ~24576, 12288 -> diverge at ~29600, 16384 -> no divergence up to 48k (so looks like window alignment matters). uploaded kv fingerprints + run logs to s3://redwood-evals/orpheus_prefill/1845678901.tar.gz
ml-bot: queued longprefill delta job (id: lp-91234). float16 baseline success; int4 vector kernel shows divergence.
Ravi: hypothesis: prefetch id generator (per-request) + shard reindex uses counter that can wrap when window boundaries cross. under int4 vector kernel chunking, ordering changes exposing reuse. add handshake guard to validate fingerprint before applying prefetch.
Omar: for triage matrix: PREFETCH_WINDOW={8192,12288,16384}, ROTARY_RESCALE={legacy,adaptive}, KERNEL={scalar,vector}. Also add `--prefetch-sync=1` test to disable async path.
Camille: ops, can we reserve 3xA100 for a 2h canary to run full matrix? @ops-bot
ops-bot: reserving 3xA100 for team-ml on 2024-11-08T03:00Z-2024-11-08T05:00Z. ticket OP-7821.
Nina: plan: run matrix tonight, collect kv fingerprints and rope-phase traces, then bisect quant commits if divergence correlates. If reproducible, ship handshake id guard as hotfix and canary.
Ravi: I can handle bisecting kernel commits tomorrow. Camille, want to own the canary?
Camille: happy to. will watch INF-1511 and coordinate rollout. :thumbsup:
Nina: logs snippet for quick glance:
```
[02:14:11] prefetch push shard=1 win=12288 id=0x3c21 req=0x55aa
[02:14:12] handshake ack shard=1 id=0x3c21 req=0x55aa
[02:14:13] token-check expected=token_29601 actual=token_29600
```
Nina: adding checklist to ticket INF-1511: [ ] matrix runs complete [ ] kv diffs uploaded [ ] bisect results [ ] handshake guard PR + canary
ml-bot: longprefill jobs finished: int4-vector diverged 4/4. int4-scalar matched float baseline.
Ravi: scalar vs vector mismatch points to scheduling differences. starting kernel-level bisect.
Camille: ping when ready to run canary; I will coordinate with ops.
Nina: will update here with final triage and PR link.
